venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Awesome Tuesday at Close Company ! We started off hot with our private event with OneTrust Intuit from 4pm to 6pm.

highlights.text: We started off hot with our private event with OneTrust Intuit from 4pm to 6pm.

venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 2/11.** Event night: client ordered food for ~40 but nearly 80 (81) checked in; kitchen sent out everything incl. comped chips and bar mix, staying within the agreed BEO. Public reopened ~8:45 after flipping the room; slow and never filled back up, but a few later reservations kept energy up; bar filled right before last call with people coming from dinner. Kitchen: after the event a few chicken orders before kitchen last call. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.weather: Warmer than the last few days
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 2/11.** Many two tops in preparation for Valentine's; floor about half full most of the evening and the bar stayed full; filled around 8:30 and cleared out by 11:00. Comps $19.60. Door: slightly less cold Wednesday with strong bar seating at open (5 solos); Sarah Kaplan Moore (DK's sister) with a party of 9 from Capital One; twos seated at T8/9 for lack of large parties; brief busy at 8:30, trend of 4s at 9:30, almost empty by 11, empty by midnight. No no-shows. Kitchen: 86 arancini. Repairs: nothing new.
